input.function: async () => { const rows=[]; for(let p=1;p<=10;p++){ const h=await (await fetch('?page='+p)).text(); const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(h,'text/html'); d.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').forEach(tr=>rows.push([...tr.cells].map(c=>c.textContent.trim()))); } const ids=new Set(rows.map(r=>r[0])); const m=rows.filter(r=>r[1].trim().toLowerCase()==='northwind'&&r[3].trim().toLowerCase()==='overdue'); const custs=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r[1]))]; const sts=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r[3]))]; return {n:rows.length, uniq:ids.size, custs, sts, m, total:m.reduce((s,r)=>s+Math.round(parseFloat(r[2].replace(/[$,]/g,''))*100),0)/100}; }
